2608.02457.title: Syntax Meets Semantics: Understanding Scientific Formulae
2608.02457.paper_summary: Scientific formulae are a fundamental component of scholarly communication, yet their dual nature -- as structured syntax and carriers of semantics -- remains underexplored in scholarly information retrieval. Although prior studies show that jointly modeling syntactic and semantic modalities improves retrieval performance, the relationship between their underlying representations has not been systematically investigated. In this work, we empirically study cross-modal correspondence between formula syntax and semantics. We find that their native representation spaces exhibit extremely weak observable correspondence despite strong latent correlation, indicating a substantial representation mismatch between the two modalities. We further evaluate whether this mismatch can be reduced using standard representation learning and alignment techniques. We represent syntactic structure using graph-based encoders and semantic information using text-based encoders, then apply contrastive learning to induce a shared representation space. Results show that the learned alignment substantially improves cross-modal retrieval, suggesting that explicit representation learning can recover correspondence absent from the original representation spaces.
2608.02457.paper_summary_zh: 科學公式是學術交流的基本組成部分，但它們作為結構化語法和語義載體的雙重性在學術信息檢索中仍然未被充分探討。雖然先前的研究顯示聯合建模語法和語義模態可以提高檢索性能，但它們的潛在表示之間的關係尚未系統性地研究。在這項工作中，我們實證研究公式語法和語義之間的跨模態對應。我們發現它們的原生表示空間顯示出極弱的可觀察對應，儘管潛在相關性強，這表明兩種模態之間存在顯著的表示不匹配。我們進一步評估這種不匹配是否可以通過標準表示學習和對齊技術來減少。我們使用基於圖形的編碼器表示語法結構，使用基於文本的編碼器表示語義信息，然後應用對比學習以誘導共享表示空間。結果顯示，學習到的對齊顯著改善了跨模態檢索，這表明顯式表示學習可以恢復原始表示空間中缺失的對應關係。
2608.02457.author: Yuni Susanti et.al.
